question: How to transfer property in DHA?
answer: DHA transfer process: 1) NOC from DHA (2-3 weeks), 2) Pay transfer fee (1% of DC value + 1% of FBR value), 3) Register at sub-registrar, 4) Update DHA records. Total time: 4-6 weeks.

question: What is the tax on property purchase in Pakistan?
answer: Property purchase taxes: 1% Stamp Duty (on DC value), 1% Registration Fee, 1% Capital Value Tax (on FBR value), 1% DHA transfer fee. Total ~3-4% of property value. Filer vs non-filer affects rates.

question: How to verify property documents in DHA?
